# Plugin Starter

A basic JavaScript plugin for Robo.js.

<Cards>
  <Card href="/docs/framework/plugins/create" title="Creating Plugins" description="Learn how to build plugins." />
  <Card href="/docs/plugins" title="Plugin Directory" description="Browse existing plugins." />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a plugin with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <plugin-name> --template plugins/starter-js
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <plugin-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Plugin Structure

<Files>
  <Folder name="config" defaultOpen>
    <File name="robo.mjs" note="Plugin config" />
  </Folder>
  <Folder name="src" defaultOpen disabled>
    <Folder name="commands" note="Slash commands" />
    <Folder name="events" note="Event handlers" />
    <Folder name="api" note="API routes (if server plugin)" />
    <File name="index.js" note="Plugin exports" />
  </Folder>
</Files>

## Configuration

Configure your plugin in `robo.mjs`:

```javascript title="robo.mjs"
export default {
  // Plugin configuration
}
```

## Publishing

Build and publish your plugin to npm:

```bash
npm run build
npm publish
```
